title: CTC_DGE_Ablation_Benchmark: ground-truth simulation and ablation benchmark for low-input CTC RNA-seq differential expression
description:
Ground-truth simulation, real-data validation and one-at-a-time ablation of every documented design decision in the Rare_CTC_RNA_DGE_Pipeline.

Contains a negative-binomial simulator with capture dropout, a leukocyte compartment and per-sample tumour purity, calibrated to CTC data and validated under a complete null before use; twelve benchmark arms across six simulation experiments; permutation-null designs on real prostate CTC data (GEO accession GSE67980); the seven publication figures; and the manuscript together with a script that recomputes every numerical value quoted in it directly from the result tables.
